free_tier_limits: 25 result pages, 3,000 API requests, no support, and a 15-day result delay; API access is limited to 1 request/second.
rate_limits: Approximately 1 request/second; excess requests return HTTP 429 with an x-limited-for wait duration. Terms also impose 60 requests per minute per IP.
resolution_notes: docs_url: replace the 404 URL with the official API index, https://docs.leakix.net/docs/api/. free_tier_limits: official Free plan lists 25 pages, 3,000 requests, no support, 15-day delay, and 1 request/sec, https://leakix.net/plans. rate_limits: official docs specify ~1/sec, HTTP 429, and x-limited-for; Terms specify 60/min/IP, https://docs.leakix.net/docs/api/search/ and https://leakix.net/terms-and-conditions. example: official search docs require GET /search, api-key/accept headers, q, scope, and page, https://docs.leakix.net/docs/api/search/.
